title: Conformance corpus under JBMC and --engine auto: no Verified the JVM refutes (closes VF-001 with its sibling when both pass)
description:
Resubmitted for VF-001 (verification/findings.md) with one change, decided by the user on 2026-11-07: the step now runs `mkdir -p target` before `tee target/conformance-jbmc.log`. In a clean checkout lib/target does not exist when tee starts, so 20261107-172721-conformance-corpus-under-jbmc-and-engine exited 1 although its tests passed (the jbmc twin's log showed 'test result: ok. 2 passed; 0 failed' after 1236 s); the auto --confirm twin was killed by the runner's scope-name collision, since fixed (VF-021). Nothing else differs from 20261107-172721-conformance-corpus-under-jbmc-and-engine: same test, same expectation. VF-001 closes when this job and its twin pass.

Step 1d of llm-dlc/loops/sound-verdicts.md. lib/tests/conformance.rs holds 54 small Java methods (lib/tests/conformance/conformance/Conformance.java) with 93 claims, 48 of which a real JVM refutes. The cases cover the gaps and their reproducers (a negative capacity to ArrayList, HashMap, HashSet and StringBuilder; synchronized (null); Random.nextBytes), field hiding, literal identity, class initializers that throw, exceptions (finally overriding a return, nested handlers, bounds, casts, throw null, rethrow), aliasing, null arrays, record constructors, virtual and default-method dispatch, and arithmetic edge cases (MIN_VALUE / -1, negative remainders, shift counts out of range, narrowing, overflow). A Java runner executes every call and every claim's generated harness on the JVM. The test run inline covers the tool's own checker under --gaps strict and assume. This job runs the ignored test, which puts every claim through --engine jbmc and --engine auto under --gaps strict. It fails if either engine says Verified for a claim the JVM refutes, or reports a violation whose witness does not refute the harness on the JVM.
expected: exits 0: the_corpus_agrees_with_the_jvm_under_jbmc_and_auto passes. The log lists each claim's verdict per engine. A failure lists each disagreement with the JVM, which is a finding about JBMC or the adapter to triage under the brief's Progress, not something to retry.

resources.notes: it runs every ignored conformance test: the corpus under JBMC and auto (644 s in -024759) and under auto --confirm (about 22 min in -043420); the corpus has grown to 81 cases since -021741's 18 min

steps.name: conformance corpus under JBMC and auto
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && mkdir -p target && JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 cargo test --release --test conformance -- --ignored --nocapture 2>&1 | tee target/conformance-jbmc.log
